summary: MCP servers can run ephemerally inside execution environments for the job's duration via an Ansible plugin framework, installed with ansible-builder either embedded in the image or as remote servers defined in a manifest.
questions: Can Ansible playbooks call MCP servers?
What is the difference between embedded and remote MCP servers in an EE?

How do I add an MCP server to an execution environment?
